verses.text: The one who scatters has come up against you. Man the fortress, watch the road; Strengthen your back, summon all [your] strength.
verses.textZh: 尼尼微啊，那打碎邦國的上來攻擊你。你要看守保障，謹防道路，使腰強壯，大大勉力。

verses.text: For the LORD will restore the splendor of Jacob Like the splendor of Israel, Even though devastators have devastated them And destroyed their vine branches.
verses.textZh: 耶和華復興雅各的榮華，好像以色列的榮華一樣；因為使地空虛的，已經使雅各和以色列空虛，將他們的葡萄枝毀壞了。

verses.text: The shields of his mighty men are [colored] red, The warriors are dressed in scarlet, The chariots are [enveloped] in flashing steel When he is prepared [to march], And the cypress [spears] are brandished.
verses.textZh: 他勇士的盾牌是紅的，精兵都穿朱紅衣服。在他預備爭戰的日子，戰車上的鋼鐵閃爍如火，柏木把的槍也掄起來了。

verses.text: The chariots race madly in the streets, They rush wildly in the squares, Their appearance is like torches, They dash to and fro like lightning flashes.
verses.textZh: 車輛在街上（或譯：城外）急行，在寬闊處奔來奔去，形狀如火把，飛跑如閃電。

verses.text: He remembers his nobles; They stumble in their march, They hurry to her wall, And the mantelet is set up.
verses.textZh: 尼尼微王招聚他的貴冑；他們步行絆跌，速上城牆，預備擋牌。

verses.text: The gates of the rivers are opened And the palace is dissolved.
It is fixed: She is stripped, she is carried away, And her handmaids are moaning like the sound of doves, Beating on their breasts.
verses.textZh: 王后蒙羞，被人擄去；宮女搥胸，哀鳴如鴿。此乃命定之事。

verses.text: Though Nineveh [was] like a pool of water throughout her days, Now they are fleeing; 'Stop, stop,' But no one turns back.
verses.textZh: 尼尼微自古以來充滿人民，如同聚水的池子；現在居民卻都逃跑。雖有人呼喊說：站住！站住！卻無人回顧。

verses.text: Plunder the silver! Plunder the gold! For there is no limit to the treasure-- Wealth from every kind of desirable object.
verses.textZh: 你們搶掠金銀罷！因為所積蓄的無窮，華美的寶器無數。

verses.text: She is emptied! Yes, she is desolate and waste! Hearts are melting and knees knocking! Also anguish is in the whole body And all their faces are grown pale!
verses.textZh: 尼尼微現在空虛荒涼，人心消化，雙膝相碰，腰都疼痛，臉都變色。

verses.text: Where is the den of the lions And the feeding place of the young lions, Where the lion, lioness and lion's cub prowled, With nothing to disturb [them]?
verses.textZh: 獅子的洞和少壯獅子餵養之處在哪裡呢？公獅母獅小獅遊行、無人驚嚇之地在哪裡呢？

verses.text: The lion tore enough for his cubs, Killed [enough] for his lionesses, And filled his lairs with prey And his dens with torn flesh.
verses.textZh: 公獅為小獅撕碎許多食物，為母獅掐死活物，把撕碎的、掐死的充滿他的洞穴。

verses.text: 'Behold, I am against you,' declares the LORD of hosts. 'I will burn up her chariots in smoke, a sword will devour your young lions; I will cut off your prey from the land, and no longer will the voice of your messengers be heard.'
verses.textZh: 萬軍之耶和華說：我與你為敵，必將你的車輛焚燒成煙，刀劍也必吞滅你的少壯獅子。我必從地上除滅你所撕碎的，你使者的聲音必不再聽見。
